auditEventShape.description: The minimum AuditEvent shape shared across the broker/audit-sink seam. Ported verbatim from taint-tracked-tool-broker's conformance/vectors.json (auditEventShape), which documents PROTOCOL.md section 4.1 as of protocolVersion 1.1. See PROTOCOL.md section 2 here for why this is a structural floor, not TTTB's full internal AuditEvent type.
